source: Vectors are derived from the Reed-Muller definition RM(r,m) as evaluations of all Boolean monomials of degree <= r on all points x in {0,1}^m, ordered by integer x = 0..2^m-1 (bit i is variable xi). Encoding is message · G over GF(2), where message bits are coefficients for monomials ordered by increasing degree then lexicographic variable indices. RM(1,m) decoding vectors use the Walsh-Hadamard transform (WHT) maximum-correlation rule (Hadamard / first-order Reed-Muller decoding). Expected values were computed directly from these definitions and cross-checked by exhaustive roundtrip and single-bit error correction tests in tests/test_vectors.py.
